description: This file defines the main public landing page component for the Applicant Portal, built with React. It includes multiple functional components that render sections such as Navbar, Hero, Features, TrustStrip, FAQ, and Footer, utilizing Tailwind CSS for styling, Framer Motion for animations, and FontAwesome icons. The file orchestrates the structure and presentation of the landing page UI.

methods.name: LandingPage
methods.description: Main functional component rendering the complete landing page, including navigation, hero section, feature highlights, trust indicators, FAQ, and footer.

methods.name: Navbar
methods.description: Renders the top navigation bar with logo, navigation links, and action buttons.

methods.name: Hero
methods.description: Displays the main hero section with headline, description, call-to-action buttons, and illustrative graphics.

methods.name: Features
methods.description: Shows feature cards highlighting key selling points like security, decision speed, and transparent rates.

methods.name: TrustStrip
methods.description: Displays trust indicators such as funding amounts, decision times, and partner logos.

methods.name: Faq
methods.description: Presents frequently asked questions with questions and answers in styled cards.

methods.name: Footer
methods.description: Renders the footer with company info, links, legal notices, and environment-based API documentation link.
